from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path("udt_clock_curvature_derivation_2026-09-28")
launch=json.loads((p/"LAUNCH.json").read_text())
manifest=json.loads((p/"CONSTRUCTION_MANIFEST.json").read_text())
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
root_changes={"LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md","UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md","INDEX.md","MEMORY.md"}
for n,h in launch["source_sha256"].items():
    data=(subprocess.check_output(["git","show",launch["head"]+":"+n]) if n in root_changes else Path(n).read_bytes())
    assert sha(data)==h,n
for n,r in manifest["files"].items():
    assert sha((p/n).read_bytes())==r["sha256"],n
sealed=0
for row in (p/"review/SOURCE_FIRST_SEAL.sha256").read_text().splitlines():
    h,n=row.split(None,1);n=n.strip()
    assert sha(Path(n).read_bytes())==h,n
    sealed+=1
doc=json.loads((p/"DOCUMENTATION_FREEZE.json").read_text())
for n,h in doc["files"].items(): assert sha(Path(n).read_bytes())==h,n
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed==root_changes,changed
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only"])
current=set(filter(None,subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"],text=True).split("\0")))
previous=set(launch["preexisting_untracked_paths"])
assert {n for n in current if not n.startswith(str(p)+"/")}==previous
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==launch["head"]
style=[]
for f in list(p.rglob("*.md"))+[Path(n) for n in root_changes]:
    for i,line in enumerate(f.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        if line.rstrip()!=line:style.append([str(f),i])
assert not style,style
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","source_versions":len(launch["source_sha256"]),"maintained_baseline_sources_via_git":2,"immutable_author_files":len(manifest["files"]),"sealed_source_first_files":sealed,"frozen_final_documentation":len(doc["files"]),"tracked_changes":sorted(changed),"preexisting_untracked_names_preserved":len(previous),"untracked_payloads_not_read":True,"index_empty_before_staging":True,"markdown_whitespace_findings":style},indent=2))
